_method: For each reference we searched GitHub (topics html5-game / javascript-game / phaser, awesome-html5-games, awesome-js-games), itch.io (HTML5 + MIT/CC0), js13kGames entries, Libre Arcade, OpenGames, H5 Arcade, OpenGameArt/Kenney (CC0 art), Phaser examples, GDevelop/Construct examples and Godot web exports, plus the 120 pre-verified rows in docs/GAME-CANDIDATES.md. A candidate is only vendored when BOTH its code licence and every bundled asset (sprites, sounds, fonts) are cleanly licensed and it can be stripped of trademarks. Most faithful clones of commercial games ship ripped sprites/sounds from the original (code MIT, assets not), which disqualifies them; in those cases we BUILD an original version.

dino-dash.picked: wayou/t-rex-runner (BSD-3-Clause, Chromium Authors; sprites + sounds are part of the BSD Chromium source) = EXACT source
rejected: arnellebalane/trex-runner (BSD, same code, older and less maintained)
chirag64/t-rex-runner-bot and themed forks (Kumamon/KuGou) - third-party character art of unclear licence
